scientific_role: freeze temporal windows and burned-pilot/confirmatory partitions from survey support only before any species identity, detection, nondetection, annual occupancy or source-loss event is opened

window_support_rule.eligible_island: OBJECTID has surveyed=1 in all three years t0,t1,t2
window_support_rule.reason: response-independent longitudinal-support floor only; biological event/class/leverage estimability is adjudicated later by the burned pilot

window_qualification.if_fewer: STOP before species response access; do not lower support floor or alter windows

partition_rule.burned_pilot_role: schema, source-loss-event, endpoint-class, leverage-variation and model-estimability gates only; no predictive effect counts as manuscript evidence
partition_rule.confirmatory_role: only windows not assigned to pilot may later contribute primary source-loss leverage evidence

eligible_island_set.per_window: exact intersection of the three surveyed OBJECTID sets
eligible_island_set.reason: response windows are disjoint by year; repeated island identity is longitudinal structure handled by later model/reference rather than post-outcome deletion

next_gate_if_passed: freeze first species-response firewall: pilot windows may open only fields needed for annual occupancy/source-loss estimability while confirmatory t2 outcomes remain sealed
anti_selection: do not choose overlapping three-year windows
do not change window boundaries after SED support is seen
do not lower the 25-common-island support floor
do not assign pilot versus confirmatory windows manually
do not use species richness, detection, nondetection, source loss, persistence or leverage to qualify/rank windows
do not open the Dryad species archive before successful v1.156 and v1.158 response-independent gates
